quality_filter.note: Pairs excluded if either image's FaceQNet quality score is below the bottom-N% cutoff (computed on the full scored LFW population) or if SCRFD detection failed on that image. Filtering applied via the same None-cache-entry mechanism baseline_pipeline.py already uses for undetected faces -- lfw_10fold/compute_fairness_metrics unmodified.

latency.note: Re-measured 2026-09-11 under confirmed-clean conditions (RGB-sync/telemetry apps ASUS Aura Sync + NZXT NGenuity2Helper, GoogleDriveFS, Spotify, Chrome closed; power plan switched to High performance) for a consistent footing with the ResNet-50 FP32/INT8 re-benchmark, which found the original session ran under external system contention. This variant's original figures (median 3.46ms, p95 4.06ms) were already close to the corrected ones -- as a small/fast model it was less exposed to contention effects -- but it was re-measured anyway so all six variants share the same clean-session methodology (n_warmup=100, n_runs=1000, median of 3 repeats).

latency_note: Reused from the unfiltered baseline run for this model -- latency is a per-inference model property independent of which pairs are included in the accuracy/fairness stats.
